title: Board View default fields, with total price only for financial access
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. A brand-new user (no saved Board field preference) with see-financial-data permission.
custom_steps:
1. Open Board View as the new user.
  2. Confirm the default fields: lead technician name, work order number, customer, unit number, asset, progress, total price, and status.
  3. Repeat as a user without see-financial-data and confirm total price is absent while the rest remain.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Board View's default fields are lead technician name, work order number, customer, unit number, asset, progress, total price, and the mandatory status — with total price subject to financial permission.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10048 — Story 5 Choose what is shown. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options (Draft Spec)”, Draft v0.9, requirement(s) S5-R13 (read 23 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 23 September 2026; not yet build-verified.
